title: postgresadapter/generator.go
description: The generator for the postgres-adapter component. It emits the store, its pool and its transport policy, so it owns that component's output contracts.

title: browserbackend/generator.go
description: The generator for the browser-backend component. It checks the declaration, captures the declared assets or the captured ZIP bundle, calculates the SHA-256 hashes of the inline scripts in index.html, and selects the templates to render. It also renders the separate schema package and schema.sql, so it owns the asset policy and schema grant contracts.

title: browserbackend/backend.go.tmpl
description: The emitted backend core. It sets every session and login cookie, applies the common response headers and the content security policy, matches the declared browser routes, validates a return path, serves the captured assets, inserts the public runtime metadata and the style nonce, runs the bounded startup steps and their diagnostics, bounds telemetry admission, and checks that the console, API and identity hosts do not share a cookie host.

title: browserbackend/handlers.go.tmpl
description: The emitted HTTP handlers. They run login, the callback with its state, nonce and identity checks, the session response, the sign-out confirmation page and form, provider sign-out, the login completion document, and the API proxy. They own the origin, CSRF, bearer, proxy header and sign-out contracts.

title: browserbackend/store.go.tmpl
description: The emitted session store, together with the key reader in keys.go.tmpl. It seals each record with AES-256-GCM against the hash of the cookie ID, keeps the pending login and total record limits, claims and finishes one token renewal per session, removes a session on sign-out, and deletes expired rows. It owns the storage, renewal and key contracts.

title: browserbackend/socket.go.tmpl
description: The emitted browser socket transport. It admits a socket only for an active session with an exact origin, bounds the sockets for one session and for one backend, clears the connection deadlines after it takes over the connection, relays messages under a fixed data budget, and cancels every lease for a session that ends. It owns the socket contracts.

title: browsertelemetry/generator.go
description: The generator for the browser-telemetry component. It resolves one service identity from the service name, the component setting and the browser backend peer setting, and it refuses two different explicit identities. It then emits three files into the output namespace: index.js with the resolved identity and the runtime source, index.d.ts with the public type declarations, and package.json with the pinned OpenTelemetry dependencies. It owns the identity and the declaration contracts of the emitted package.

title: browsertelemetry/runtime.js
description: The browser telemetry runtime that the component emits into index.js. It builds the trace, log and metric providers, the authenticated same-origin OTLP transport and the lifecycle methods. It holds every bound of the emitted package: the fixed signal paths, the session token, the export deadline, the request and response limits, the queue and batch sizes, the log, metric and attribute limits, the observable callback budgets, the public loss categories, the deployment metadata rules and the inert server-render path.

title: cliapplication/generator.go
description: The generator for the cli-application component. It checks the module, the output namespace and the factory package, then renders the command runtime, the configuration, output, apply, identity, session, OAuth, browser and version sources, the build identity record, the command entry point and the shared HTTPS client. The entry point it emits owns one telemetry runtime for each invocation and maps the command result to a fixed outcome.

title: cliapplication/runtime.go.tmpl
description: The command runtime that the component emits. It checks the application's definitions before any configuration read or request, parses and bounds the arguments and the request body, binds path parameters, reserves the output destination, sends one bounded HTTPS request and applies the response contract for JSON, empty and failed answers. It also converts a relative duration flag to one absolute UTC timestamp.

title: cliapplication/oauth.go.tmpl
description: The OIDC runtime that the component emits. It discovers the provider over bounded HTTPS clients, holds the restricted verification profile for ID tokens, performs the browser and device grants with S256 proof and accepts a token answer only after the issuer, audience, time, authorized party, nonce and token hash checks pass. It also keeps a refreshed session identity equal to the original identity.

title: cliapplication/config.go.tmpl
description: The configuration store that the component emits. It finds the configuration file, opens its parent directory as a root and refuses a directory that permits writes by other users. It writes the configuration with mode 0600 through an exclusive temporary file, a file sync, an atomic rename and a directory sync. It refuses an existing configuration file that permits group or other access. It keeps only an absolute reference to the token file and reads that file on demand. Logout attempts provider revocation, removes the local configuration even when revocation fails, keeps the external token file and reports the revocation error. It also bounds each input file and refuses a file that is not regular.

title: cliapplication/output.go.tmpl
description: The output destination that the component emits. It reserves the selected output file before the command reads credentials or sends its request. It opens the parent directory as a root and refuses a directory that permits writes by other users. It creates the file with exclusive creation and mode 0600, so it refuses an existing file, a symbolic link and a device. It returns the error and sends no file output to stdout after a file failure. It syncs the file and the directory after a write, keeps the file when a write fails, and removes an unwritten reservation at close.

title: cliapplication/identity.go.tmpl
description: The identity command that the component emits. It builds its report only from the fields of a successful API response and from the configured API address. It puts no locally decoded claim, no access token and no other response field into that report. It requires the output file option before it shows a raw or a decoded token. It refuses the raw and the decoded options together. It reserves the output file before it reads credentials, so a failed identity request or a failed decoding leaves no output file.

title: cliapplication/session.go.tmpl
description: The session guard that the component emits. It holds a persistent lock file on the configuration and waits for it, so concurrent processes refresh a token once. It reads the external token file through the configuration on each request. It saves the pending refresh state before it sends the token request, while it holds the lock. It refuses a session with a pending refresh and asks for a new login, so it never uses the old refresh token again. It also revokes a session at the provider.

title: cliapplication/apply.go.tmpl
description: The apply command that the component emits. It checks every document and resolves every target before it starts a resource write. It stops before any write after a lookup failure, a malformed or ambiguous list answer or a missing required create field. A dry run reports the validated status and returns before it reads credentials, refreshes a session or contacts the API. It reports one status for each document, reports the unknown status for an uncertain write and writes each resource once. Its results hold only the kind, the name, the identifier and the status, so they hold no spec value and no API error body. It gives an immutable resource the unchanged status and sends it no PATCH and no DELETE.

title: cliapplication/apply_input.go.tmpl
description: The apply input reader that the component emits. It accepts only the JSON subset of YAML. It walks each YAML node and refuses an anchor, an alias, a merge key, a custom tag and a duplicate key. It refuses invalid Unicode, a NUL byte and a number that is not valid JSON. It keeps each number as an exact JSON number, so a large integer stays exact. It bounds the document count, the byte count, the node count and the depth. It inspects each named file with a link check and opens it without link following, so it refuses a symbolic link, a FIFO, a device and a file that is not regular.

title: cliapplication/apply_immutable.go.tmpl
description: The immutable apply support that the component emits. It requires that an immutable identity names unique required string create fields, and it refuses a definition that also declares patch fields. It builds the lookup search from the exact values of those fields, so it finds the resource by exact identity. It compares the stored row with the requested fields and reports a difference as an error. It also refuses a malformed or an ambiguous list answer before any write.

title: controller/generator.go
description: The generator for the controller component. It emits the watch runtime, the keyed scheduler, the cursor scanner, the sweep runtime, the state codec and journal, the metrics monitor and the process entry point, so it owns that component's output contracts. The runtime, keyed, scan, sweep, process and state templates hold the session rules, the scheduling rules, the page rules and the privacy rules.

title: gosdk/generator.go
description: The generator for the go-sdk component. It loads the captured OpenAPI document and its declared references, bounds the input, runs the pinned wire generator with the nullable type option, renders the shared bounded HTTPS transport, and emits the public typed client package.

title: gosdk/client.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted public SDK client. It checks the bearer token, builds the bounded HTTPS transport, keeps the request bridge private, bounds the active calls, and bounds the wait in Close.

title: grpcapplication/generator.go
description: The generator for the grpc-application component. It compiles the declared protobuf contracts, renders the runtime, the client, the stream header helper and the timestamp conversion, and binds the domain registration factory and the optional event source to the generated supervisor.

title: grpcapplication/runtime.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted gRPC runtime: its TLS configuration, the verifier interceptors, the admission and message limits, the unary deadline, the stream lifetime and input and output timeouts, the error and panic isolation, the registered cleanup list and the prepared registrar.

title: grpcapplication/client.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted outbound gRPC client: its fixed credentials and server identity check, its per-call private token read, its call and stream limits, and the bounded stream wrapper that completes client telemetry on every terminal path.

title: grpcapplication/stream_headers.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted stream header helper. It checks each declared header requirement for name shape, value shape, duplication and count before it reads a stream, and reports a contract error without touching the stream.

title: grpcapplication/conversion.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted checked timestamp conversion, shared by the grpc-application and grpc-processes components. It bounds the protobuf instant range, keeps optional presence, owns each result and drops the monotonic clock and the local zone.

title: grpcapplication/mapping.go
description: The response mapping emitter of the gRPC generators. It matches the declared provider model fields and prepared inputs to the compiled protobuf message, and emits pure conversion functions with their presence, ownership, numeric, timestamp and JSON bounds.

title: grpcapplication/standalone.go
description: The grpc-processes generator. It accepts only the process and protobuf settings, requires a JWT verifier and telemetry, refuses a storage contract or a primary API factory, and emits the compiled contracts, the shared transport and one executable for each declared process.

title: grpcapplication/process.go
description: The process runtime emitter shared by the grpc-application and grpc-processes components. It checks the domain Open declaration, renders the process package and renders one main program for each declared process, with its initialization, supervision, failure isolation and shutdown bounds.

title: grpcapplication/process_health.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted process health monitor and probe command. It validates the monitor address, serves only the liveness and readiness paths from the process state, and runs a bounded probe that does no domain work.

title: healthcheck/generator.go
description: The generator for the health-check component. It emits the sampling monitor, the liveness and readiness handlers and the optional application monitor, and it registers both probe routes on the top-level mux, so it owns that component's output contracts.

title: httpapplication/generator.go
description: The generator for the http-application component. It renders the transport package, the HTTPS client, the field projector and the response mapping package, and it binds the domain HTTP factory to the generated runtime that owns the database, the server limits, signal handling and request draining.

title: httpclient/client.go.tmpl
description: The source of the bounded HTTPS client that this component emits into the application's client package. It fixes verified TLS 1.3, one origin, the request and response limits, the request permit count, the stream limits, the private credential file rule and the optional certificate pin. Other components render the same template, so the contracts it keeps are shared.

title: httpapplication/endpoint.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted transport package: the endpoint and reply endpoint builders, the strict JSON body reader, the order parser and the response limits. It owns the request lifecycle contracts of the component.

title: httpapplication/fields.go.tmpl
description: The source of the emitted bounded list projector: the field schema, its copy and bounds, the selector parser, the list projection and the optional projection adapter.

title: httpapplication/responses.go
description: The response mapping emitter of the http-application component. It reads the captured OpenAPI object and the provider's Go model, checks that each declared property has one rule, and emits pure conversion functions with their encoding, numeric, timestamp, enum and JSON bounds.

title: jwtauth/generator.go
description: The generator for the jwt-auth component. It emits the verifier, the HTTP middleware, the JWKS key set, the remote key source, the key telemetry hook and the grant policy, so it owns that component's output contracts. It also validates the header, the mode and the role claim path before it generates.

title: kafkaproducer/generator.go
description: The generator for the kafka-producer component. It emits the single-topic publisher and the runtime that joins the publisher to the outbox worker, so it owns that component's output contracts. The publisher template holds the transport rules, the credential-file rules, the acknowledgement policy and the uncertain-result policy.

title: keycloakprovider/generator.go
description: The generator for the keycloak-provider component. It emits the realm-bound administrator client, the checked native, browser and service-account lifecycles, the role, scope and mapper operations, and the service-account token proof, so it owns that component's output contracts. It requires the generated HTTP application client and a shared JWT verifier peer.

title: keycloakprovider/managed.go
description: Reads the managed_clients component settings and generates the identity and binding helpers for each declared kind. It gives every ownership attribute the reserved stego.owner. prefix and builds the legacy rename map, so it owns the component's ownership binding contract.

title: kubernetesclient/generator.go
description: The generator validates its context and then emits exactly ten Go files into the component's output namespace. It requires a Go-safe output namespace and a bound `application-http` peer, and it fails when the generated HTTP client is absent. It parses each embedded template with the output package name and the peer transport import path, formats the result, and checks that every file belongs to the declared namespace. The withdrawn pinned admission prototype is not in that list, so it cannot reach a generated project.

title: kubernetesclient/client.go.tmpl
description: This template emits the core resource client. It reads the private token file for each request, forces `fieldValidation=Strict` on writes, and rejects a malformed write path or query before any I/O. It decodes responses with exact JSON numbers and refuses anything that is not one JSON object. `Ensure`, `PatchOwned` and `DeleteOwned` require the caller's ownership labels, the observed UID and the observed resource version, never retry a conflict, and never change the caller's objects. `APIError` and `FailureSummary` expose only the method, the status and the retry delay.

title: kubernetesclient/observe.go.tmpl
description: This record covers the package observation templates: observe.go.tmpl, discovery.go.tmpl, watch_set.go.tmpl, readiness.go.tmpl and route.go.tmpl. They emit the bounded list and watch with its reset and replace discipline, the uncached API requirement check, the assigned namespace watch sets with their aggregate limits, the Deployment availability check, and the passthrough Route admission with its probe order. They make no network call of their own for an observation check.

title: kubernetesclient/tls_secret.go.tmpl
description: This record covers the package Secret and credential templates: tls_secret.go.tmpl, secret_set.go.tmpl, secret_state.go.tmpl and image_pull_secret.go.tmpl. They emit the TLS Secret and client certificate verifiers with their explicit trust pool, the trust bundle parser, the Secret set with its data digest and its validate-before-write order, the durable Secret state helper, and the image pull credential operation with its namespace identity checks. Their errors carry no Secret or credential data.

title: kubernetesservice/generator.go
description: Validates the deployment declaration and assembles the service manifest template. It builds the restricted Pod with a non-root security context, the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile, a read-only root filesystem, no privilege escalation and all capabilities dropped. It sets the HTTPS probes on /livez and /readyz, the explicit TLS environment, the ClusterIP Service and the NetworkPolicy. The policy declares both policy types, adds the DNS rule, and refuses an ingress peer for a port the workload does not expose. Unbound external endpoints stay as a CIDR value that Kubernetes refuses.

title: kubernetesservice/render.go.tmpl
description: The renderer that the component emits with each project. It checks the image digest, the namespace and the file group before it renders. It expands each external endpoint binding into one host prefix and one TCP port, and refuses a missing, unknown, repeated or out-of-scope binding. It adds image pull Secret references, selects an existing account, sets the configuration digest annotation, splits the cluster and namespace scopes by known resource kind, and applies owner labels without replacing a generated label.

title: kubernetesservice/allocation_policy.go
description: Builds the allocation admission policies, their denying bindings and the allocator ClusterRole. Every policy fails closed and every binding denies. The namespace, quota, binding, cluster binding, network policy and ServiceAccount checks each require the installation marker, the profile, the owner label and the manager value. The allocator role grants no Secret, admission policy or RuntimeClass access, and limits NetworkPolicy access to the reserved name. The complete policy set has a size limit.

title: kubernetesservice/allocation_pods.go
description: Reads the Pod runtime class, the Pod account and the isolated settings of a profile, then builds the Pod admission policy and its denying binding. The policy selects the immutable allocator and profile labels. It requires current allocation identity and the declared Pod security level. It adds the runtime rule only when the profile declares a class, and adds the sealed account and explicit token rule when the profile declares an account. It applies to Pod creation, Pod updates, status writes and ephemeral container writes, and it appends each application rule after the common checks.

title: kubernetesservice/workers.go
description: Validates worker declarations and writes their image files, entry point and manifest template. The Containerfile builds with CGO disabled from a digest-pinned builder image into a scratch runtime stage with user 65532:65532 and an explicit entry point. The ignore file excludes the whole context, then permits the module files and the declared source directories, and excludes hidden files and private-key extensions. Each worker manifest contains an account, a network policy and a Deployment with one replica and the Recreate strategy, and no Service, container port or ingress rule.

title: kubernetesservice/rpc.go
description: Validates each RPC process declaration and writes its image files and manifest template. It resolves the peer component and the one declared process, and it checks the factory source directory. It gives the Deployment one replica, and it uses RollingUpdate with one extra Pod and zero unavailable Pods unless the declaration selects Recreate. It sets the gRPC listener to port 9090 with the certificate and the key files from the mounted file Secret, and it sets the monitor address to a loopback address. It exposes only the container port 9090 and gives the Service exactly that one port. Its startup, readiness and liveness probes run the process entry point with a probe mode.

title: kubernetesservice/allocation_control_accounts.go
description: Builds the control account admission policy and the control-account installer ClusterRole. The policy reserves the fixed control account names and permits their creation only to an identity that holds the installer capability. The ClusterRole declares that single non-resource capability with the get verb. The generator emits no ClusterRoleBinding for that role, so an operator must bind it to a trusted deployment identity. It gives the capability to no other generated object, so a namespace owner and an allocator never obtain it.

title: kubernetesservice/local_application.go
description: Adds the local application container to the browser Pod. The container listens on a loopback address and reads its settings from its own environment Secret. It receives its own file Secret volume and its own temporary volume, and it shares no volume with the browser container. It declares no container port, so the Pod exposes it to no other Pod. It drops all capabilities, refuses privilege escalation and uses a read-only root file system. It receives no OAuth, session, database or public TLS material and no service account token.

title: kubernetesworkload/workload.go.tmpl
description: The construction library that the component emits with each project. Build checks the declaration, then returns a Deployment and an optional ClusterIP Service. It fixes non-root execution, the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile, a read-only root filesystem, denied privilege escalation and the removal of all Linux capabilities. It permits only Secret, ConfigMap and bounded emptyDir volumes, mounts the first two read-only, and gives a Secret file mode 0440. It requires a digest-pinned image, three HTTP probes for each container against that container's own ports, positive requests within the limits, and exactly the dependencies that the mounts and Secret environment references name. It sets the configuration digest annotation on the Pod template and keeps dependency contents out of the result. Fields that this profile owns use explicit null values when the declaration omits them.

title: oteltracing/generator.go
description: The generator for the otel-tracing component. It emits the telemetry runtime, its validated export settings, the trace, log and metric providers, the HTTP, client, database, controller, startup and outbox signal helpers and the auth key refresh hook, so it owns that component's output contracts.

title: outbox/generator.go
description: The generator for the outbox component. It emits the PostgreSQL queue, its SQL migration, the delivery worker and the live event source, so it owns that component's output contracts. The queue, worker and source templates hold the transaction rules, the lease rules and the notice rules.

title: postgresclient/generator.go
description: The generator for the postgres-client component. It emits the explicit read operation, the logical database lifecycle, the schema callback and the credential helpers, so it owns that component's output contracts. The client, provision, schema and credential templates hold the transport rules, the session rules, the ownership rules and the telemetry rules.

title: restapi/generator.go
description: The generator for the rest-api component. It emits one handler per collection, the router and its storage interface, the RFC 9457 problem type and its constructors, the OpenAPI document, the request validation middleware, the CORS middleware and the discovery handler. It therefore owns every output contract of the component except the route patterns.

title: restapi/http_routes.go
description: The route table of the rest-api component. It maps each collection operation to one HTTP method and path, adds the three unauthenticated discovery routes, checks each path and each parameter name, and declares the patterns to the compiler before rendering. It owns the base-path and route-shape contracts.

title: rhssoauth/generator.go
description: The generator for the rh-sso-auth component. It calls the jwt-auth generator for the shared verifier and key source, then emits the SSO handler with its exact public paths and the SSO claim mapping, so it owns that component's output contracts. It also validates the issuer, the key endpoint and the public path list before it generates.

title: runtimeconfig/generator.go
description: The generator for the runtime-configuration component. It emits one typed settings struct, one loader and one explicit reader for each declared group, so it owns that component's output contracts. The configuration template holds the lookup rules, the default rules, the type rules, the error rules and the redaction rules.

title: tslsearch/generator.go
description: The generator for the tsl-search component. It emits the search engine and the field map for the declared entities, so it owns that component's output contracts. The search template holds the input limits, the field checks, the parameter binding and the SQL conversion.

title: typescriptsdk/generator.go
description: The generator for the typescript-sdk component. It loads the captured OpenAPI document and its declared references through the shared bounded loader, refuses the unsupported schema features, bounds the declared public error codes, and emits the ES module, the separate request and response model declarations and the package metadata.

title: typescriptsdk/runtime.js
description: The browser transport this component emits. It fixes the HTTPS browser origin, the same-origin fetch settings, the session CSRF exchange before a mutation, the input and response checks, the size, time and concurrency bounds, the private error shape, the login and logout routes and the per-operation trace context.
